_readme: Project list, read by js/projects.js. One entry per project, sorted by date automatically (newest first). 'featured': a number puts the project on the home page, in that order. Edit freely, like a Data Table: no code needed. Each project has a 'fr' block for the French site (same fields; missing ones fall back to English).

projects.title: Kläppen
projects.pitch: A cozy building game: snapping building system, PCG resources per biome, HISM optimisation.

fr.pitch: Un jeu de construction cozy : système de construction avec snapping, ressources PCG par biome, optimisation HISM.

fr.pitch: Une IA volante 3D 100 % Blueprint qui esquive les obstacles en temps réel, conçue comme IA de départ modulaire et comme tutoriel de ma certification Unreal Authorized Instructor.
